title: The Wardmoor archivist's sealed-shelf puzzle only offered its might/grace fallback options after the will-based 'persuade' option was tried and failed once (costing Watch standing) — a player who doesn't retry after a 'no' would never learn forceful alternatives existed.
where: The Record-House, Highward / talk to the archivist
